summary: Complete frontend testing of EaseMyBooking Farmhouse & Villa static site (HTML/CSS/JS). All 13 review requirements verified successfully across farmhouse-villas.html, property-details.html and list-property.html. Zero console errors on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: script.js is 535 lines and contains data + multiple page controllers in one file. Consider splitting PROPERTIES array into a separate data.js and detail/list controllers into separate JS files as the codebase grows.
Property amenity checkboxes in list-property.html have no individual data-testid attributes (only the parent fields do). Adding data-testid="own-amenity-<n>" would improve test robustness.
Date inputs in enquiry form use browser-native date pickers. This is acceptable for a no-framework HTML/CSS/JS app (no shadcn available), looks consistent.
Static files served via /app/frontend/public/ leverage CRA dev server. Acceptable for preview, but production should serve via dedicated static host/CDN.
seed_data_creation: PROPERTIES array seeded in /app/frontend/public/script.js (9 properties: azure-retreat, sapphire-crest, golden-acres, emerald-garden, crimson-fields, heritage-haveli, snowline-manor, tropic-bungalow, palm-grove). 3 featured: azure-retreat, sapphire-crest, golden-acres.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static site - no backend, no APIs. Test via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /<page>.html. All WhatsApp deep-links go to wa.me/918824880979. Owner email info@easemybooking.in. Use window.open interception (override window.open) to capture wa.me URLs in tests. window.location cannot be redefined in Chromium — verify mailto via code review or by listening to navigation events.
